description: This file defines the 'Ip' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension related to fraud detection via IP addresses. It handles displaying, adding, removing, installing, and uninstalling IP-based fraud rules, as well as managing IP lists with pagination.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class managing IP-related fraud functionality within the OpenCart admin extension for the Opencart raud namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main IP fraud management view with breadcrumbs, list of IPs, and page setup.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of IP fraud settings via POST data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of the IP fraud extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of the IP fraud extension.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of IP addresses flagged for fraud, along with total associated customers, and outputs the view.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP to the fraud IP list after validation.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes a specified IP from the fraud IP list.
